applicabilityBasis.summary: AA_FalconXUSDC is the exact Ethereum FalconX credit-vault LP token, representing an interest-accruing institutional lending position. Deposited USDC is sent to the borrower, with exits dependent on repayment and lending cycles. No fixed monetary-value payment obligation is established for the vault share. The USDC parent is a separate asset.

genius.notes: The tracked address is an Ethereum LP share, not the newer/other Optimism facility, Falcon Finance USDf, or a MEV Capital token. FalconX is described as borrower and M11 Credit as curator, neither establishing an exact legal token issuer or a GENIUS route. issuerEntity is omitted. The token accrues lending performance and repayment risk; USDC reserve attestations or Circle authorizations do not apply to this vault receipt. This scope call does not adjudicate separate securities law.
